spend.description: where one UTC day's model requests went, tallied from each request's `usage` and `context_parts`: by part of the context, session, task, model and large entry, each as tokens by how they were paid (read from the provider cache, written to it, sent fresh, generated) and dollars. Dollars are what the provider reported, else the tokens at the model's list `price`. The totals are measured; the split across parts, and across the tasks a session worked on, is estimated

requests.description: how many model requests it tallies

tokens.description: its tokens as [read, write, fresh, generated]

parts.description: by part of the context (`persona <id>`, `tool <name>`, `skills`, `system`, `result <tool>`, `call <tool>`, `input`, `notice`, `output`, `reasoning`, `checkpoint`, and `unrecorded` for a request whose context was not recorded): [read, write, fresh, generated, dollars]

tasks.description: by task eid, each session's share split evenly across the tasks it worked on, a subagent's across the tasks its brief names, else as the session that started it: [tokens, dollars]

models.description: by model eid: [read, write, fresh, generated, dollars, requests]

plans.description: by the account whose plan its requests billed against (a transcript's request the account whose directory keeps it, a native harness's the account its provider's CLI signs in with here; a request paid per token bills none): the dollars they ran up on it, in all and by part, session, task, model, entry and (`metered`) each model's by session, which is what a limit on one model counts. Against that account's weekly limit, its dollars say what share of the week each row used

unpriced.description: the model eids a request was tallied for that had no `price` and reported no dollars: what they cost is missing from the dollars, not zero. Also kept per account, so an account's rate is known incomplete

entries.description: the transcript entries that cost most as they were carried request after request, by eid: [tokens, dollars]

untallied.description: a past day some of whose requests were written after it ended, as when a transcript is read in after the fact: on its day's row until the duty tallies that day again

spend_show.title: Show where the tokens went
spend_show.description: Report where the model requests of a span of days went, from the tallies the duty keeps: each plan limit against its pace, a line for each topic with a share of the week (attended.share) saying how much of it the topic's sessions used, then the parts of the context, sessions, tasks, models and large entries that cost most, by dollars. Reads tallies only; changes nothing.

since.description: the first UTC day, `2026-10-13`, `yesterday` or `3 days ago` (default: the day the Claude plan's week began, else six days ago)

until.description: the last UTC day, written as since is (default: today)

top.description: how many rows each ranking shows (default 10)

plans.description: true reports only each plan limit against its pace, one line each, as the Spend page shows first

spend_backfill.title: Measure past requests and tally their days
spend_backfill.description: Read every transcript and managed run's log written since a day again for its model requests (@yaks/session and @yaks/spawn `recounted`), walk the graph's own sessions for theirs, then tally each day since. Running it again leaves what is there alone.

since.description: the first UTC day, `2026-10-13`, `yesterday` or `3 days ago`
